jobs.title: Cocoa Pricing & Position Manager
jobs.description:
About the Role

We are looking for a Cocoa GCA Pricing & Position Manager to join our team in Zürich. In this role, you will be at the center of Barry Callebaut’s global cocoa business, leading the execution of position management, risk exposure monitoring and cocoa pricing for strategic Global Corporate Account (GCA) agreements.

You will combine strong analytical capabilities with commercial acumen to translate complex market movements, position exposures and customer requirements into actionable decisions. Working closely with Trading, Risk Management, Sales, Finance, Operations and regional pricing teams, you will ensure accurate position tracking, effective hedging, robust contract execution and competitive pricing strategies.

As the owner of key position management activities, you will oversee global cocoa exposures, support hedging execution and contribute to risk optimization across regions and systems. At the same time, you will act as a trusted partner to customers and internal stakeholders, helping to develop pricing solutions, manage commercial agreements and support strategic business decisions.

You will gain deep visibility into Barry Callebaut’s global cocoa network (from origin sourcing to customer delivery) and develop a strong understanding of global cocoa flows, supply chain dynamics and market interdependencies. Your insights will help strengthen the connection between our Cocoa and Chocolate businesses by providing market intelligence that supports commercial and pricing decisions across the value chain.

Beyond day-to-day execution, you will have the opportunity to contribute to global projects, process improvements and digitalization initiatives that enhance transparency, efficiency and decision-making across the business.

Key Responsibilities include

• Lead the execution and monitoring of global cocoa positions, ensuring accurate exposure management, position reconciliation and alignment with hedging and risk management strategies.

• Own end-to-end position management activities, including volume consolidation, position calculations, synthetic exposure management, terminal market hedging and internal risk transfers.

• Monitor and analyze market exposures, financial impacts and risk positions, providing actionable insights to Trading, Risk Management and commercial teams.

• Execute cocoa pricing activities for Global Corporate Account agreements, ensuring accurate, timely and compliant contract implementation.

• Act as a central partner for customers and internal stakeholders by aligning on pricing strategies, position impacts and commercial execution requirements.

• Manage contract portfolios across assigned customers, including bookings, amendments, extensions, balance reconciliations, intercompany contracts and terminal market adjustments.

• Support daily hedging activities and ensure all relevant risk components are accurately reflected across systems, contracts and reporting tools.

• Drive market quotations and ad-hoc pricing requests, supporting sales teams with competitive, commercially sound and risk-aligned proposals.

• Develop pricing solutions for new products, customer agreements, certifications, origins and supply flows while ensuring commercial viability and effective risk management.

• Analyze forecasted, contracted and delivered volumes to support forecasting, budgeting, demand planning and commercial decision-making.

• Build strong customer relationships through regular engagement, acting as a key contact for pricing, contract execution and market-related discussions.

• Drive continuous process improvement by enhancing reporting, increasing transparency, strengthening controls and supporting automation initiatives.

• Contribute to global projects related to cost optimization, flow optimization, contingency planning, supply chain efficiency and business performance improvement.

About You

• 5+ years of experience in commodity trading, position management, pricing, sales or risk management.

• Strong analytical mindset with the ability to interpret complex market, position and financial data and translate it into meaningful business insights.

• Solid understanding of hedging principles, futures markets and commodity risk management.

• Commercially minded with the ability to balance market dynamics, customer needs and business objectives.

• Comfortable working independently while also being a collaborative team player in a global environment.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with fluency in English; additional languages are an advantage.

• Experience building effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders across functions and regions.

• Cocoa market expertise, including futures markets, bean origins, cocoa products and pricing mechanisms, is highly valued.

• Good understanding of supply chain and logistics, including Incoterms, contract structures and global cocoa flows.

• Experience with SAP, BW and data analysis tools is an advantage.

• Curious, proactive and continuously looking for opportunities to improve processes, increase transparency and create value through data-driven decision-making.

jobs.title: Investor Relations Manager
jobs.description:
About the Role

We are seeking a hands-on Investor Relations professional to act as a close partner to the Head of Investor Relations across all core IR activities. You will play a key role in shaping investor communications, supporting engagement with the investment community and working closely with senior leadership. The role is ideal for an experienced IR or capital markets professional who thrives in a dynamic, fast-paced environment and wants to help build a best-in-class Investor Relations function.

Key Responsibilities Include

• Investor communication and disclosure

• Lead and coordinate preparation for quarterly earnings and key investor communications, leading drafting of earnings releases, presentations, scripts, Q&A documents, annual report and other supporting materials

• Shape clear, consistent and compelling narratives around financial performance, strategy and long-term value creation

• Ensure accuracy, clarity and alignment of messaging and continuously enhance equity story

• Investor & analyst engagement

• Play a central role in virtual and in-person investor and analyst meetings, conferences and roadshows

• Build and maintain strong relationships with institutional investors and sell-side analysts, serving as a responsive and credible point of contact

• Lead investor targeting and engagement strategies, track and synthesize investor feedback, sentiment and positioning

• Monitor sell‑side analyst coverage, models and consensus expectations

• Financial analysis, market intelligence & insights

• Build and maintain financial models, valuation frameworks and scenario analysis to support IR messaging and strategy

• Monitor and synthesize market trends, industry/peer developments, macro factors and capital markets dynamics

• Prepare concise insights and briefings for senior leadership and Board of Directors

• Team & functional support

• Support the development and execution of Barry Callebaut’s overall IR program and strategy

• Actively coach and develop more junior team members, particularly in financial analysis and capital markets fundamentals

• Cross‑functional collaboration with Strategy, FP&A, Accounting, Communications, Legal and other internal stakeholders

About You

• 5-8 years’ experience in Investor Relations at a listed company, and/or sell-side or buy-side equity research, investment banking or similar capital markets role

• Strong understanding of capital markets, investor perspectives and public company disclosures with experience working with institutional investors and financial analysts

• Industry experience in consumer, food or ingredients is a plus

• Advanced proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint

• Familiarity with IR and capital markets platforms (e.g. FactSet, Bloomberg, NASDAQ)

• Strong understanding of financial statements, valuation methodologies and drivers of long-term shareholder value

• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to craft credible and compelling narratives and presentations for senior leadership and external stakeholders

• Proven financial modelling and analytical capability, with ability to interpret, challenge and explain assumptions and outcomes

• Ability to synthesize and translate complex financial, operational and strategic topics into clear and impactful investor-ready narratives

jobs.title: Category Manager Packaging
jobs.description:
About the role

As a Packaging Category Manager you will be tasked with accurately procuring packaging materials at the best overall value ready for production, ensuring that quality, cost and delivery are all balanced. You will be working with suppliers covering all aspects of the purchase from putting commercial terms in place to ensuring that packaging materials are delivered as per agreed conditions. You will be managing the strategic sourcing process for specific assigned categories of packaging materials over Barry Callebaut sites primarily in Europe and Africa, as well as globally, according to the defined strategies and drive to increasingly incorporate best in class techniques and industry benchmarks.

Key responsibilities include

• Prepare & implement the sourcing category strategy for the materials in scope, in close collaboration with the category buyers team and Packaging Sourcing Director, to make sure that purchasing goals are well achieved, according to the business priorities, Group policies and principles.

• Assist with the development of an Annual Savings target and the budget preparation for the following year; ensure up-to-date Savings Tracking.

jobs.description:
About the role

We are looking for a part-time (60%) management assistant to provide valuable support to the VP of Corporate Communications & Public Affairs, located at our Head Office in Zurich. Additionally, this role is part of the broader Zurich Assistant Network, whose aim is to exchange best practices, deepen the knowledge of business topics, develop skills and provide mutual support to enable our senior leaders reach their business objectives.

Key Responsibilities Include

• Proactive management of the VP’s agenda to ensure structure and optimal use of time, coordinate and schedule meetings across global time zones, prepare agendas, ensure follow-up as needed.

• Complex international travel arrangements (booking flight, hotel, transportation, request visas, etc.)

• Prioritizing conflicting needs, proactively addressing issues, managing competing priorities and ensuring reliable follow-through to resolution

• Support with the creation, formatting, and maintenance of PowerPoint, Word, and Excel documents as needed

• Vendor management (vendor set-up, PO creation and approvals, code and approve invoices)

• Expenses management (submit expense report, approve expenses) and vacation approvals for the team

• Support on-boarding of new team members (coordinate on-boarding agenda, help with materials, training schedule, etc.)

• Build efficient and professional working relationships with internal and external stakeholders, act as a first point of contact

• Support in event organization (team events, activities & dinners) and presents (Birthday, Christmas, anniversaries, etc.)

• Support with the annual general meeting of shareholders

About You

• Ideally 5+ years of experience as a Management or Executive Assistant in a similar role in an international environment

• Familiarity with Corporate Communications related topics, experience in those departments is a plus

• Appropriate vocational or University training (either in business/ economics, as a management/ executive assistant, or related field)

• Proficient in English, German language knowledge a big plus, other languages are an advantage

• Strong computer literacy with experience of full Microsoft Suite, Success Factors, SAP, Concur, and ServiceNow preferred

• Ability to organize, multi-task, and work under pressure

• Passionate, quick thinker, creative and an effective problem solver

• Ability to prioritize and switch between tasks to meet deadlines

• Great communicator, service-oriented mindset and attitude, proactive with a can-do attitude

• Highly organized with an independent and efficient way of working

• Strong stakeholder management - experience in interacting with people of all levels in the organization

The Head of Global Media & Content leads the company’s external narrative and content ecosystem to strengthen reputation, support strategic priorities and enhance visibility with key stakeholders. This is a senior role within Corporate Communications, responsible for shaping and delivering a consistent, high-quality narrative across all external channels. The role goes beyond traditional media relations to integrate social media and corporate storytelling into a single, aligned content strategy. The role acts as a strategic advisor to senior leadership and on external positioning, messaging and visibility. The role sets the strategic direction, standards and governance for how the company is represented externally across media, social platforms and corporate storytelling. It ensures a consistent, credible and differentiated narrative that supports the Group’s strategic priorities, strengthens reputation and enhances visibility with key stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities Include

Global Content Strategy & Narrative:

• Define and drive the global content strategy aligned with corporate priorities

• Translate business strategy into a clear, compelling and differentiated external narrative

• Ensure consistency, quality and relevance across all external content

• Act as final editorial authority for key external materials such as financial results.

Media Relations & Reputation Management:

• Lead global media strategy and proactive positioning

• Build relationships with key journalists and influencers

• Shape external narratives on complex topics

• Oversee media engagement, issues and crisis communications

Integrated Content & Channels:

• Own external content ecosystem including media, social and storytelling

• Ensure integrated cross-channel approach

• Partner closely with Regional Communications teams to support strong local execution,

• Define and maintain clear global guardrails for media engagement, social media and external content to ensure consistency and quality across markets

• Act as a central point of expertise and advisory support for regions while preserving regional ownership and flexibility

• Advise CEO and ELT on external positioning

jobs.title: Manager, Group Accounting & Reporting
jobs.description:
About the role

The role of Manager Group Accounting and Reporting (GAR) plays a crucial role in ensuring high‑quality financial reporting, technical accounting compliance, and consistent application of IFRS across the Group. The role strengthens the integrity of consolidated financial information, drives alignment of accounting practices globally, and provide expert guidance on complex accounting matters. This position partners closely with regional finance teams, the Group consolidation function, and cross‑functional stakeholders to deliver accurate reporting, strong governance, and continuous improvement of Group‑wide accounting processes.

Key Responsibilities Include

• Act as the Group’s IFRS technical expert, supporting regional and local teams on complex accounting topics and new standards

• Specific focus on financial instruments, fair valuation and hedge accounting: IFRS compliance, systems and processes

• Prepare robust accounting documentation, policies and position papers for complex transactions and significant accounting areas

• Develop and maintain Group accounting policies, reporting guidelines, and best practices to ensure consistent application across entities

• Partner with the Group consolidation team to ensure a smooth, timely, and accurate period close

• Build and maintain a strong internal network across regions and functions (FP&A, Tax, Treasury, Legal) to support Group‑wide initiatives

• Support transformation initiatives, system enhancements, and process optimization projects within Group Finance

• Provide high‑quality internal reporting and analytical insights on consolidated results to senior management

• Contribute to the preparation of external disclosures for the Annual Report, Half‑Year Report, and other regulatory filings

• Monitor emerging IFRS developments and assess their impact on the Group

About You

• Minimum 7 years in a professional accounting firm (Big 4 a plus) or multinational/listed company environment

• Exceptional knowledge of technical accounting under IFRS (formulating policy, drafting memos and compliance in practice)

• Expertise and experience in accounting for commodities and derivatives, fair valuation and hedge accounting

• Experience in a global team and external reporting for a listed (preferably SIX) entity

• Demonstrates very positive attitude in a dynamic, matrix and multi-country business environment

• Knowledge of SAP ERP and Group consolidation systems

• Advanced proficiency in Excel and standard business applications

• Applied data-driven mindset in leveraging BI tools for financial insights and reporting optimization

• Agent of change in technical, process and system implementation of fair valuation and hedge accounting policies and best practice

• Curiosity and intellectual agility to navigate complex accounting topics

jobs.title: Commercial Excellence Manager - FM & Specialties
jobs.description:
About the Role

Barry Callebaut’s future relies on strengthening customer trust while navigating shifting markets and rapid technological change. To achieve this, we are sharpening a unified Customer Experience (CX) ambition that moves us beyond a commodity mindset and positions us as the trusted advisor to our customers’ brands - helping them create distinctive, sustainable chocolate experiences.

As part of one of three Global CX Centers of Excellence, the Commercial Excellence Manager - Food Manufacturers & Specialties shapes and drives the global Commercial Excellence agenda for the Food Manufacturers segment and Specialties category, in close partnership with regional Sales, Marketing, R&D, Chocolate Academy, and Operations.

The role ensures that commercial teams continuously improve Customer Experience across the entire Customer Journey.

The position also collaborates closely with the other CX CoEs (Global Accounts, Gourmet) to deliver a seamless, end to end BC Commercial Excellence journey on cross segment priorities such as outsourcing, productivity, and pricing excellence.

Key Responsibilities Include

• Accelerate Growth across Industrial Accounts and Retailers by supporting key commercial initiatives

• Embed Commercial Excellence through Salesforce adoption, including playbooks, dashboards, and account planning

• Strengthen Strategic Account Planning for FM, Retail & Chains with clear governance and adoption tracking

• Activate Winning Portfolio with customers by partnering closely with Marketing and enabling commercial teams

• Enhance Pricing Excellence by supporting strategic pricing initiatives and improving end‑to‑end pricing processes

• Improve Master Data & Systems to streamline internal workflows and elevate customer experience

• Align with Global Specialties to ensure Commercial Excellence initiatives directly support category growth

• Translate Strategy into Action by converting BC 6–8 initiatives into Commercial Excellence programs within the Customer Journey

• Accelerate Specialties Growth through capability building in solution‑selling and cross‑selling

• Strengthen Strategic Partnerships via standardized SLAs and contract management for FM, Retail & Chain customers

• Advance Pricing Maturity through the Next Level Pricing initiative, improving contract pricing, quotation experience, and value‑in‑use monetization

• Develop Commercial Excellence Academy content in collaboration with the CX Learning team

• Lead Global Content Exchange for FM, Retail & Chains, ensuring consistent updates on innovation, sustainability, quality, and services

• Identify Global Big Bets using Commercial Intelligence and drive corrective actions to support growth

• Provide Targeted Support to Chains and Retail segments as needed

About You

• At least 7 years of experience in senior commercial roles, ideally within global B2B commercial organizations

• Commercial / Sales Excellence expertise, including Key Account Management excellence, CRM governance, commercial capability building, and execution excellence

• Strong experience managing sizeable markets and large customers across multiple route‑to‑market models, particularly with Key Accounts and brand owners

• Demonstrated ability to deliver through cross‑functional collaboration, working effectively across diverse teams and organizational levels

• Knowledge of chocolate, cacao, and specialties categories is a strong plus

• Experience in working in Multi-matrix organization

• University degree, preferably MBA; completion of an Executive Leadership Program is a plus

• Fluent English, plus 1 additional language; German and French are an advantage

To achieve this, we are sharpening a unified Customer Experience (CX) ambition that moves us beyond a commodity mindset and positions us as the trusted advisor to our customers’ brands - helping them create distinctive, sustainable chocolate experiences.

As part of one of three Global CX Centers of Excellence, the Commercial Excellence Manager - Food Manufacturers & Specialties shapes and drives the global Commercial Excellence agenda for the Food Manufacturers segment and Specialties category, in close partnership with regional Sales, Marketing, R&D, Chocolate Academy, and Operations.

The role ensures that commercial teams continuously improve Customer Experience across the entire Customer Journey.

The position also collaborates closely with the other CX CoEs (Global Accounts, Gourmet) to deliver a seamless, end to end BC Commercial Excellence journey on cross segment priorities such as outsourcing, productivity, and pricing excellence.

Key Responsibilities Include

• Accelerate Growth across Industrial Accounts and Retailers by supporting key commercial initiatives

• Embed Commercial Excellence through Salesforce adoption, including playbooks, dashboards, and account planning

• Strengthen Strategic Account Planning for FM, Retail & Chains with clear governance and adoption tracking

• Activate Winning Portfolio with customers by partnering closely with Marketing and enabling commercial teams

• Enhance Pricing Excellence by supporting strategic pricing initiatives and improving end‑to‑end pricing processes

• Improve Master Data & Systems to streamline internal workflows and elevate customer experience

• Align with Global Specialties to ensure Commercial Excellence initiatives directly support category growth

• Translate Strategy into Action by converting BC 6–8 initiatives into Commercial Excellence programs within the Customer Journey

• Accelerate Specialties Growth through capability building in solution‑selling and cross‑selling

• Strengthen Strategic Partnerships via standardized SLAs and contract management for FM, Retail & Chain customers

• Advance Pricing Maturity through the Next Level Pricing initiative, improving contract pricing, quotation experience, and value‑in‑use monetization

• Develop Commercial Excellence Academy content in collaboration with the CX Learning team

• Lead Global Content Exchange for FM, Retail & Chains, ensuring consistent updates on innovation, sustainability, quality, and services

• Identify Global Big Bets using Commercial Intelligence and drive corrective actions to support growth

• Provide Targeted Support to Chains and Retail segments as needed

About You

• At least 7 years of experience in senior commercial roles, ideally within global B2B commercial organizations

• Commercial / Sales Excellence expertise, including Key Account Management excellence, CRM governance, commercial capability building, and execution excellence

• Strong experience managing sizeable markets and large customers across multiple route‑to‑market models, particularly with Key Accounts and brand owners

• Demonstrated ability to deliver through cross‑functional collaboration, working effectively across diverse teams and organizational levels

• Knowledge of chocolate, cacao, and specialties categories is a strong plus

• Experience in working in Multi-matrix organization

• University degree, preferably MBA; completion of an Executive Leadership Program is a plus

• Fluent English, plus 1 additional language; German and French are an advantage

jobs.title: Executive Assistant CPCO
jobs.description:
About the Role

The Executive Assistant to the Chief People & Culture Officer (CPCO) and VP Global Total Reward provides high level administrative and organizational support to enable effective leadership and smooth daily operations. Serving as a trusted partner, this role ensures efficient coordination, clear communication, and strong stakeholder engagement.

Beyond supporting the CPCO, the Executive Assistant leads the Zurich Assistant Network, driving best practices, mentoring peers, and acting as a central coordination point for internal stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities Include

Executive Support

• Manage and optimize the CPCO’s agenda, ensuring time is allocated to the highest value priorities

• Coordinate complex meeting scheduling, prepare briefing materials, and ensure timely follow ups

• Handle all travel arrangements, including flights, accommodation, transportation, and visa requirements

• Manage invoices, vendor setup, and expense reporting for the CPCO

• Prepare materials, presentations, and documentation for internal and external engagements

Stakeholder & Communication Management

• Serve as a professional and trusted point of contact for internal and external stakeholders

• Build strong working relationships across all levels of the organization

• Ensure clear, timely, and effective communication between the CPCO, leadership teams, and key partners

• Maintain the highest level of confidentiality when handling sensitive HR and organizational matters

Operational & Team Support

• Organization of the annual Chairman’s Awards

• Support the organization of team events, leadership meetings and offsites

• Coordinate onboarding for newcomers, including agendas and integration support

• Track key deliverables, follow up on action items, and help drive operational excellence within the HRLT

Leadership within the Assistant Community

• Lead the Zurich Assistant Network, fostering collaboration and continuous improvement

• Mentor peers, share best practices, and contribute to building a strong, cohesive assistant community

• Act as a central coordination point for assistants supporting leaders

About You

• Commercial apprenticeship with further education as an Executive Assistant (Direktionsassistentin) or equivalent

• Minimum 7–10 years of experience supporting senior executives in fast‑paced, multinational environments

• Demonstrated experience supporting C‑suite leaders, ideally within HR or people‑centric functions

• Fluent in German and/or Swiss German and English; additional languages are an asset

• Strong IT proficiency, particularly in the Microsoft 365 environment

• Experience working in complex, matrixed organizations with multiple stakeholders

• Experience with Concur, SAP, SuccessFactors, and ServiceNow

• Familiarity with HR processes, terminology, and organizational dynamics

• Experience leading or contributing to an assistant network or community of practice
